simple.meaning: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָסַף (H3254) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 210 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָסַף (yâçaph) means to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 14 13.

definitions.short: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)
definitions.usage: add, × again, × any more, × cease, × come more, conceive again, continue, exceed, × further, × gather together, get more, give more-over, × henceforth, increase (more and more), join, × longer (bring, do, make, much, put), × (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be (strong-) er, × yet, yield.
